# `review` command

Report the lint findings on the changed lines only: staged, since a base, or uncommitted.

```bash
fobis review [PATHS...] [options]
```

How to use it, with examples: [Code quality](/cookbook/analysis).

<!-- cli:begin -->
<!-- generated by docs/scripts/gen_cli_reference.py from the command line: do not edit -->

## All options

Arguments: `PATHS...`

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--fobos`, `-f` | TEXT |  | Specify a "fobos" file named differently from "fobos" |
| `--fci` |  |  | Assume fobos inputs as case insensitive |
| `--mode` | TEXT |  | Select a mode defined into a fobos file |
| `--src`, `-s` | TEXT |  | Root-directory of source files [default: ./] |
| `--base` | TEXT |  | Review the commits since the merge base with this reference (e.g. origin/master). |
| `--staged` |  |  | Review the staged change (pre-commit hook). |
| `--worktree` |  |  | With --base: review up to the working tree (uncommitted changes included). |
| `--context` | INTEGER | `0` | Also report findings this many lines away from a changed line. |
| `--select` | TEXT |  | Rule ids or prefixes to run (repeatable, comma-separated; 'ALL'). |
| `--ignore` | TEXT |  | Rule ids or prefixes to skip (repeatable, comma-separated). |
| `--format` | TEXT | `text` | Output format: text, markdown (pull-request comment), json, sarif, github. |
| `--compiler-feedback` | TEXT |  | Build log with compiler optimisation reports (see fobis lint). |
| `--deep` |  |  | Add an LLM risk summary of the change, with citations (text, markdown, json). |
| `--deep-context` |  |  | Print what the model would receive for --deep, run no model. |
| `--exit-zero` |  |  | Exit 0 even when findings are reported. |
| `--varset` | TEXT |  | Apply [varset:NAME] bindings. |

<!-- cli:end -->
